english.title: Fail to comply with requirement to provide name and address under Modern Slavery Act 2015
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, failed to comply with a requirement to provide a name and address contained in a

(A)_[slavery and trafficking prevention order]_
(B)_[interim slavery and trafficking prevention order]_
(C)_[slavery and trafficking risk order]_
(D)_[interim slavery and trafficking risk order]_

made on **(..SPECIFY DATE ORDER MADE..) by **(..SPECIFY COURT..) in that **(..SPECIFY THE NATURE OF FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 30(2)(b) and 30(3) of the Modern Slavery Act 2015.

english.notes: An order for conditional discharge is not available to the sentencing court

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and / or a fine
Indictment: maximum 5 years imprisonment

Time Limit for Prosecution:
None

Note
(i) An order for conditional discharge is not available to the sentencing court.
(ii) The maximum penalty on summary conviction may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates' court, see section 30(3) of the Modern Slavery Act 2015 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.
